mechanism: Clotrimazole inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2D6, potentially increasing nortriptyline plasma concentrations and risk of anticholinergic and cardiac effects.
action: Monitor for increased nortriptyline adverse effects (dry mouth, urinary retention, tachycardia, QT prolongation); consider nortriptyline dose reduction or ECG monitoring if using systemic clotrimazole.
